name: Costa Rica
agenda: 조직범죄 대응과 치안 강화(대형 교도소 가동, 미국과 안보 협력)
5개 헌법 개정안(대외차입 국회 승인 제한·부채 한도, 감사원장 임기 단축 등) 추진

econ.payment: 콜론은 비교적 안정적이고, 2026-10-23 456.14에서 11-07 452.13으로 소폭 강세다. 달러 결제가 널리 쓰인다.

agenda: Organised-crime crackdown and security (new mega-prison, security cooperation with the US)
Five constitutional reforms (limits on Assembly approval of foreign loans and a debt cap, shorter Comptroller term, etc.)
Bill for a 15% tax on foreign interest, dividends, rent and capital gains
Bilateral-FTA trade strategy after shelving CPTPP (response to the 12.5% US tariff)
Road infrastructure such as widening Route 1 (San José-San Ramón)

biz.title: Road ITS and traffic management systems

econ.payment: The colón is fairly stable and edged stronger from 456.14 (2026-10-23) to 452.13 (2026-11-07); US dollars are widely used.
econ.rating: S&P BB / Moody's unconfirmed / Fitch unconfirmed

notices: 2026-10-28 Announced shelving of the CPTPP accession bid and replaced the foreign trade minister
2026-10-05 Appointed a new foreign minister (Ana Elena Pinto)
2026-09-17 Sought an urgent meeting with Colombia's president on security and counter-narcotics

en.leader: President Laura Fernández Delgado (head of state and government, took office 2026-05-08, term 2026-2030)
needs: Security, corrections and surveillance technology against organised crime
Road widening and traffic management (cameras and radar every 1.5 km planned on Route 1)
Broader tax base and modern tax administration (70% of inspected businesses non-compliant)
Export market diversification after the 12.5% US tariff (estimate)

projects.detail: Passed first debate with 31 ruling-party (PPSO) votes. It cuts or freezes deferred university funds and Judiciary allocations. The deadline for second debate is 29 November.
projects.title: 2027 national budget

projects.budget: US$770m loan from CABEI and the OPEC Fund
projects.detail: 55.6 km in seven sections. MOPT published the tender on 2026-10-21, with construction from H2 2027 and completion within six years. (single source)
projects.ministry: Ministry of Public Works and Transport (MOPT)
projects.title: Route 1 widening, San José (La Sabana) to San Ramón

projects.detail: Held more than 600 inmates eight days after the first transfers; a core project of the security policy. (single source)
projects.title: Maximum-security prison (CACCO) in operation

projects.detail: A government bill to tax residents' foreign interest, dividends, rent and capital gains at 15%. (single source)
projects.title: 15% tax on foreign income bill

sanctions.summary: No country-wide UN, US, EU, UK or Korean sanctions programme applies; a 12.5% US tariff on Costa Rican goods has applied since 2026-07-24 (not a sanction).

en.summary: The Fernández government is focused on tough security policy and state reform, with former president Rodrigo Chaves serving as Minister of the Presidency and Finance. The ¢12.4 trillion 2027 budget passed first debate, and the CPTPP accession bid was shelved on 2026-10-28.
watch: The 12.5% US tariff is expected to remain after the US midterms
Shelving CPTPP delays access to Asian markets, especially Japan
Procurement transparency issues such as the fire service's single-bidder ambulance purchase

summary: 페르난데스 정부는 강경 치안 대책과 국가 개혁을 앞세우며, 전임 로드리고 차베스 대통령이 대통령실·재무부 장관을 겸한다. 2027년 예산 12.4조 콜론이 1차 독회를 통과했고, 2026-10-28 CPTPP 가입 추진은 보류됐다.
